checks.lead: Max Brod (Hebrew: מקס ברוד; 27 May 1884 – 20 December 1968) was an Czech author, music critic, composer, and journalist, born as a German-speaking Czech. He is notable for promoting the work of writer Franz Kafka and composer Leoš Janáček.
